protocol.goal: nonempty human-readable useful consumer quality goal

validation.criteria: Array<{id,caseId,evaluator:ImprovementPin,objectiveVersion,thresholdVersion,verificationClass,kind:'behavior'|'detection'|'control', fixedDefect?:ImprovementPin, validControlIds?:string[]}>; detection requires fixedDefect and validControlIds referring to control criteria

protocol.allowedChanges: exact repository-relative files or directory prefixes ending /

QualityObservation.results: Array<{id:string,criterionId:string,consumerId:string,consumerVersion:string,output:ImprovementPin,provenance:ImprovementPin,exposure:ImprovementPin,evidenceScope:'source'|'adapter'|'native-observation',properties:CaseResultProperties}>; properties passed/verdict describe criterion satisfaction (detection success means fixed defect detected); properties.unitRef=criterion.caseId

captured.assessment: status ready-for-comparison|ready-for-review|repair|defer|stop; outcome behavior-gain|verification-detection-gain|mixed-gain|preserved|regression|insufficient; per-criterion transitions with baseline/candidate verdict/evidence class/scope/source refs; no efficiency scalar or acceptance
limits: all declared criteria mandatory and candidate must satisfy every one
independence/exposure/pins are supplied evidence declarations, never authenticated native permission or actual exposure
boundary breach and known scope/usage excess survive malformed observations
unknown/incomparable evidence defers; insufficient baseline is never a demonstrated gain

content.claim: Pre-observation engineering contract/oracles; caller evidence is not native permission or source authentication.
